item.title: Akaneiro no Kyoukaisen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ALcot Honey Comb
  • 発売日: 2017-06-30

  • 日本語名: 茜色の境界線
  • 英語名: Akaneiro no Kyoukaisen

别名

  • Madder／Border

あらすじ

One night, Shuu met the fox spirit Tomoe. In order to become a goddess, she must subdue the ‘tatari’ (curses) which devour all. Shuu’s hometown of Kanbe has been struck by these curses since some time, and despite the efforts of Tomoe and the half-youkai Kasumi, their numbers have only increased. Now Shuu’s kouhai Shion has also become targeted by them. In order to protect his hometown and those precious to him, Shuu joined the fight against the tatari. As they cross the line between the human and demon worlds, the world becomes dyed madder red.

  • 英語名: Soshite Hatsukoi ga Imouto ni Naru

别名

  • 然后初恋成为了妹妹

あらすじ

Having faced many hardships as a child, the cynical Kazuharu believed that the world was a wasteland and the only way to survive it was to work your hardest. There’s no time for playing nor falling in love, like the rest of his classmates.

While he was working hard as usual, he saw a mysterious girl with a uniform he did not recognize. She appeared to always avoid the gaze of others. Normally he wouldn’t pay much attention, but for some reason he was particularly interested in her. Then suddenly one day, she became his imouto.

别名

  • とな恋

あらすじ

Akito’s parents wed late in life after repeated failed marriage meetings. They both passed away a few years ago due to illness. In their last words, they lamented not having found their love while they were young. Now the track and field club’s manager at Keisen Academy, a sudden decision was forced upon him. His grandmother Chiyo was worried about her grandson’s future after his parent’s failed marriage and tearfully appealed to him to find a bride while she’s still alive. If he was unable to do so within a week, then he would be forced to marry whomever she chooses.

item.description:

  • 英語名: Aka-san to Kyuuketsuki.

别名

  • Aka-san and Vampire.

あらすじ

It was an odd time for Yuu to transfer to Niiyatomori Gakuen. Other than being able to fall fast asleep anywhere, he’s a pretty normal guy. Within half a month, he had made three friends. Shuugetsu is smart, handsome and a model student… if he could just keep his mouth shut. Shuugetsu’s osananajimi Kamui is an active girl who looks like a cool beauty… except she turns awfully delusional at the sight of anything cute. The long black-haired student council president Konoha is perfect in every way… until at important moments when extreme nervousness takes over.

item.title: Dang! Dang! Danchizuma -Watashi Dake no Danna-sama ♥-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ALcot Honey Comb
  • 発売日: 2013-04-26
  • スコア: 6.2/10 (23 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Dang！ Dang！ 団地妻 -わたしだけの旦那さま♥-
  • 英語名: Dang! Dang! Danchizuma -Watashi Dake no Danna-sama ♥-

あらすじ

Hayato is a normal student, except for the fact that he’s the owner of an apartment complex which he inherited from his parents. One day, while he was thinking of what to put on the tenant recruitment pamphlet, a memory from his childhood popped up in his head. His first love had told him her dream was to become an apartment wife. So he jokingly wrote down that he was looking for an apartment wife. After a while, he got a call from a prospective renter. She was relieved that there was still a room left for her, as this fulfilled her dream of becoming an apartment wife. When he met her, he couldn’t believe his own eyes: she was his first love who had moved away 10 years ago.

item.title: Aete Mushi Suru Kimi to no Mirai ~Relay Broadcast~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ALcot Honey Comb
  • 発売日: 2012-11-30
  • スコア: 7.38/10 (189 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あえて無視するキミとの未来 ～Relay broadcast～
  • 英語名: Aete Mushi Suru Kimi to no Mirai Relay Broadcast

あらすじ

Takurou can see the future. No matter if it’s in his dream or as an image that suddenly comes to his mind, it will certainly happen. However, having this special ability isn’t without its demerits. He knows how he will end up after graduation, as well as for the rest of his life. He cannot bring himself to be excited about anything since putting in effort is futile when the end result is already decided. One day, a peculiar transfer student Souka appeared before him, something that he had not seen in his future. She told him that his future is his own creation and it isn’t something that is decided from the beginning. Then, Takurou saw a future in which she became his girlfriend. Which future will be his? Is it already decided?

item.title: Aneiro
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ALcot Honey Comb
  • 発売日: 2011-06-24
  • スコア: 7.13/10 (59 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アネイロ
  • 英語名: Aneiro

あらすじ

Kou returns to Japan after a few years overseas to attend school and reunite with his older sister Kaoruko and osananajimi Ena. They are overjoyed that he is back together with them. Little did he know that they are quite well-known at school: Kaoruko as the Jeanne d’Arc Scientist and Ena as the Emerald-Eyed Witch. There’s a huge commotion now with him around and the student council leader Sayaka declares that she will disband any club that doesn’t have anything to show by the end of the month. This puts Kaoruko’s science club and Ena’s astro-divination club in danger. Of course, they come and ask Kou to help them!

item.title: Kicking Horse★Rhapsody
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ALcot Honey Comb
  • 発売日: 2010-11-26
  • スコア: 6.69/10 (53 人評価)
  • 日本語名: キッキングホース★ラプソディ
  • 英語名: Kicking Horse★Rhapsody

あらすじ

There’s a saying that goes: “Those who disturb the love of others should be killed by a horse’s kick”. However, it’s not only people that are obstacles in love. There’s lack of money, lack of time together and other little accidents that threaten romance. And of course, there’s actually no horse to kick people. So that’s why the “Kicking Horse Rhapsody” is here! They’ll get rid of all the nuisances so couples can focus on furthering their love. Souta realizes that he’s surrounded by three attractive girls within the group. However, how can he possibly fall in love with a girl when the other girls will be jealous and try to get in their way?

あらすじ

Kurou was reading a book in the library when he saw his older sister Shizu fall from the roof. Fortunately, she wasn’t hurt badly. Kuro and their osananajimi Ruri are happy that she’s fine and don’t ask her what happened. Later, he finds out from his classmate Wakaba that she was fighting against some mysterious men. It is because they are after him, as he possesses the elixir of immortality ‘ochimizu’, so he decides to take part in the battle as well.

item.title: Real Imouto ga Iru Ooizumi-kun no Baai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ALcot Honey Comb
  • 発売日: 2010-05-28

  • 日本語名: リアル妹がいる大泉くんのばあい
  • 英語名: Real Imouto ga Iru Ooizumi-kun no Baai

あらすじ

Ryou has played lots of eroge and loved lots of (2D) imoutos. However, one imouto has stolen his heart. Voiced by his favourite seiyuu and drawn by his favourite illustrator, Mai is not like his real imouto, Shiori, who treats him like garbage and sees him as nothing more than a disgusting eroge-playing maniac. No, Mai would take a bath with him, hold hands with him on the way to school… it’s totally different from reality. One night, Ryou had a strange dream. When he woke up in the morning, he found Mai straddling him… “Good morning, onii-chan!”

あらすじ

Kouya, a rookie detective, is walking deep inside the forest. It was two weeks ago, a hand of an unidentified creature washed up on the shore of a river. Hard and thick skin, bristle like an animal, thick fingers and sharp nails, it was not a human’s hand. Also, there was a jewel ring on the ring finger.
